edition.notes: A catalog-level identification of the conventional received Latin text (DH 1000-1002) of the constitution promulgated 29 January 1336. No exact artifact of a printed Denzinger edition is retained or hashed; publication audits that quote Latin phrases record the public web transcription actually consulted. The 1336 Latin act is public domain; particular printed editions of Denzinger retain their own editorial rights.
edition.publication: Latin text of the constitution as printed in Denzinger-Hünermann, Enchiridion symbolorum, definitionum et declarationum de rebus fidei et morum, nn. 1000-1002
edition.title: Benedictus Deus — Latin text as received in Denzinger's Enchiridion symbolorum

alternate_titles: Constitutio Benedictus Deus de visione Dei beatifica
On the Beatific Vision of God
work.author: Benedict XII
work.description: Benedict XII's apostolic constitution of 29 January 1336 defining that the souls of the saints, before the resurrection of the body and the general judgment, see the divine essence with an intuitive and even facial vision, no creature mediating, and are truly blessed with eternal life and rest.
work.title: Benedictus Deus
